title: Verify: runUntrack exit code and script unit tests
summary: Unit tests for runUntrack success, failure and script wiring
description: Add tests/untrackScript.test.ts covering runUntrack with fake runner and log/err spies, and a check that the script source uses runUntrack.
acceptance_criteria: Script source references runUntrack and no longer calls untrackNodeModules directly
technical_constraints: Read script file with node:fs readFileSync; no git execution

steps.action: Create a vitest file with three tests. (1) fake runner returning 'node_modules/a\0' then '' for ls-files; vi.fn log and err; expect return 0, log called with 'untracked 1 paths', err not called. (2) fake runner whose second ls-files listing is 'node_modules/a\0'; expect return 1 and err called with a message containing 'node_modules/a'. (3) readFileSync of scripts/untrackNodeModules.ts contains 'runUntrack' and 'process.exitCode'.
